Name: Pelican Town Portfolio - Finance Overhaul
Author: littlelodgegames
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Put your gold to work around Pelican Town.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Pelican Town Portfolio lets you buy shares in familiar local businesses by speaking directl[/color][color=#d4d4d8]y with their owners. Build a portfolio, benefit from shareholder discounts, and collect a share of each business’s profits every Monday.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Business results respond to the season, town conditions, and your activities. Your purchases contribute to shop revenue, while things such as festivals, rainy weather, livestock, fishing, and mining can influence particular businesses. Business values change over time, giving you another reason to follow their performance.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The Financial Dashboard brings your investments and farm finances together. View your holdings, discounts, portfolio value, current cash, weekly income, and expenses. Expand a business heading for more detail, or open your latest Financial Report.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Prefer to keep things simple? Your Monday letter summarises the week, with dividends already paid into your wallet.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod archive.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the[/color]

[code]PelicanTownPortfolio[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your Stardew Valley[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load your save and check your mailbox for the introduction letter.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Eight investable businesses:[/b] Pierre’s General Store, Marnie’s Ranch, Stardrop Saloon, Carpenter’s Shop, Fish Shop, Blacksmith, Harvey’s Clinic, and JojaMart.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Conversations at shop counters:[/b] Choose “Talk business” to buy shares, sell eligible holdings, or ask how business is going.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Weekly dividends:[/b] Receive your share of business profits every Monday.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Partial-week earnings:[/b] Dividends account for how many nights you held your shares.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shareholder discounts:[/b] By default, every 5% owned provides a 1% discount, up to 5% at the default maximum holding.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Changing business values:[/b] Shop performance affects what your investments are worth.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Financial tracking:[/b] Review income and spending across shipping, shop transactions, animals, buildings, upgrades, and other categories.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Three dashboard pages:[/b] Portfolio, This Week, and Last Report.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Introduction and report letters:[/b] Learn how investing works and reread previous reports through Collections.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Configurable rules:[/b] Adjust ownership limits, share increments, prices, dividends, discounts, participating businesses, controls, and letters.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Support for GMCM[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url], using a release compatible with your game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with new and existing saves.[/*]
[*]Default share purchases are in [b]5% increments[/b], with a maximum [b]25% holding per business[/b].[/*]
[*]Newly purchased shares earn dividends immediately but cannot be sold until Monday by default.[/*]
[*]Dividends depend on profits; a business may pay nothing in an unprofitable week.[/*]
[*]JojaMart is available while it remains open. If it closes permanently, your holding is bought back at its last value during the following Monday settlement.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support is [b]host-only[/b]. The mod tracks the host’s wallet and portfolio.[/*]
[*]Progress follows the game’s saving behaviour. Quitting without saving rolls back the day’s transactions and payouts.[/*]
[*]Configuration is available in
[code]config.json[/code], generated after the first launch. Financial rule changes take effect the following morning.[/*]
[*]Mods that substantially change shop counters or purchasing behaviour may need compatibility testing. The counter prompts can be disabled in configuration.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Pelican Town Portfolio
Manifest.Description: Buy a stake in Pelican Town's businesses, collect dividends every Monday, and read a weekly Financial Report of your farm's money.
Manifest.Author: Little Lodge Games
